component.name: OrquestraAI
component.summary: Keep skills, MCP servers and sessions consistent across AI coding agents

description.p: OrquestraAI is a desktop control plane and CLI for several AI coding agents at once. It holds skills, MCP servers, instruction files, sessions and credentials in one place and projects them into Claude Code, OpenAI Codex, xAI Grok, Antigravity, Freebuff, GitHub Copilot CLI, Hermes Agent, OpenCode and Kilo Code.
This Flatpak exists for distributions whose glibc or WebKitGTK is older than the release binary requires: it carries its own runtime, so the host only needs a working Flatpak installation.
Windows shell, signed macOS bundle and the Linux compatibility gate.
